integrity: Three separate Python standard-library programs reconstruct the finite claims; an explicit 48-orbit census and structured numerical certificate accompany them.
scientific_limitations: The classification and sharp metric concern only the finite 35-vertex graph KG(7,3); the metric is computationally certified for all 840 configurations, not inferred for larger Kneser graphs. Possible unindexed historical equivalents and independent validation remain unresolved.
title: Fano antiflags and optimal sensor relocation in \(KG(7,3)\)
